TransactionType.name: Transaction Type
TransactionType.definition: Code that indicates the type of transaction being undertaken in accordance with ISO 8583, Transaction Type.

TransactionSubType.name: Transaction Sub Type
TransactionSubType.definition: Further breakdown of the transaction type being performed.

OtherTransactionAttribute.name: Other Transaction Attribute
OtherTransactionAttribute.definition: Other transaction attribute defined at national or private level.

Cancellation.name: Cancellation
Cancellation.definition: Indicates the previous message is cancelled.

MessageReason.name: Message Reason
MessageReason.definition: Reason or purpose to send the message.

AlternateMessageReason.name: Alternate Message Reason
AlternateMessageReason.definition: Supports message reason codes that are not defined in external code list.

PreAuthorisationTimeLimit.name: Pre Authorisation Time Limit
PreAuthorisationTimeLimit.definition: Contains the period (expressed in minutes) within which a merchant is expected to complete the transaction.

TransactionDescription.name: Transaction Description
TransactionDescription.definition: Transaction data related to programmes and services, content and format based on bilateral agreements.
